correctness.rationale: Literal scan of all 15 masks (choose(6,4)) and all 2^16 two-by-eight binary arrays gives 12 spanning masks with the identical 64 solutions and three two-column masks with zero solutions. A two-column mask contains both sites in each of its two columns, forcing duplicate all-zero windows on swapping row translation. Exact 16-site, four-bit windows constitute an exhaustive bijection test. Translation orbits of 64 arrays split 16×4; complementation/reversal merge them into two 32-member classes, and row-XOR alternation was independently confirmed. Source's verify_direct.py was read, plus independent clean enumeration of the finite domain.
residual_risks: Finite cross-checks cannot substitute for general proofs; exact finite enumeration applies only to stated domains.
